sources.entry: Material Colors Native - Choose your Material colours and copy the hex code.

summary.one_liner: A native macOS app for picking Google Material Design colours and copying their hex codes, built with react-native-macos.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Material Colors app for OS X where you choose a colour and click to copy its colour code. It is heavily inspired by the MaterialColorsApp project. The author built it with react-native-macos to test react-native-desktop, and says it is a roughly 2.5 MB app compared with about 114 MB for an Electron-based alternative. To run it, you clone the repo, run npm install, then open osx/MaterialColors.xcodeproj in Xcode and press Run. The README does not describe the palette contents or other features in detail.
use_cases: pick Material Design colours for a UI
copy hex colour codes on a Mac
lightweight alternative to Electron colour pickers
how_to_run: Hit the Run button in Xcode
notable: Small app size, about 2.5 MB versus about 114 MB for the Electron-based MaterialColorsApp
Click a colour to copy its hex code
Built on react-native-macos rather than Electron
caveats: Requires building from source in Xcode; no prebuilt download link is given in the README text
Little documentation and no stated license or maintenance status
